title: Jobs (cloud)
description: Every scheduled and person-run Cloud Run job: executions, failures, schedules and missed runs, then each project's task attempts, run lengths, CPU and memory.

panels.title: Scheduled runs: a successful run within each job's deadline
auth-publisher
panels.description: Successful executions of `auth-publisher` in the last 6 minutes: its missed-run deadline (3 minutes, about one and a half cadences) plus three, because Cloud Run's job metrics can arrive up to 180 s after the run. MISSED: none, so its `missed run` policy is open or about to be. Reads "paused" or "database stopped", in no colour, while `auth-db` is stopped on purpose (the service's TPA_PAUSED_JOBS, TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES).

panels.title: feed-ingest
panels.description: Successful executions of `feed-ingest-everon-sync` in the last 723 minutes: its missed-run deadline (720 minutes, about one and a half cadences) plus three, because Cloud Run's job metrics can arrive up to 180 s after the run. MISSED: none, so its `missed run` policy is open or about to be. The administrator-feed importer's Everon sync runs at 06:00, 14:00 and 22:00 Chicago time, never retried, and alerts on one failure (`feed-ingest-failed`); its `missed run` policy exists only while its schedule is unpaused. Beta's alone: production-full builds none of it. Reads "not deployed", in no colour, while `feed-ingest-everon-sync` is not built (beta's switch off; the service's TPA_NOT_DEPLOYED_JOBS), whatever else holds. Reads "paused" or "database stopped", in no colour, while `feed-ingest-everon-sync` or `auth-db` or `tpa-db` is paused or stopped on purpose (the service's TPA_PAUSED_JOBS, TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES).

panels.title: App project jobs (tpa-jobs, auth, the importer)
Successful executions, by job
panels.description: A gap where a job's cadence says a run should be is a missed run.

panels.title: Failed executions, by job
panels.description: Executions that failed after their retries: two in a row open `jobs-failed` (R380); one opens `audit-chain` for the audit jobs (urgent) and `feed-ingest-failed` for the importer. For tpa-jobs a failed run is any tenant not `ok`.

panels.title: Schedules that could not start their job
panels.description: Cloud Scheduler attempts that finished in error, by schedule and status (`scheduler-failed`). PERMISSION_DENIED means an invoker binding is not what the gate thinks.

panels.title: Run summaries, by job
panels.description: One per tpa-jobs scheduled run (`tpa_jobs_runs`); the drains' ticks are on the Portal & API page.

panels.title: Alerts raised, by job
panels.description: Alert records the scheduled runs raised in the time range (`jobs-alerts`; the paging ones urgent; two `tenants_partial` in a day `jobs-partial-recurring`).

panels.title: Reconciliations left open per tenant
panels.description: The outstanding reconciliations accumulator_reconcile left open, one point per tenant per run. `accumulator-backlog-growing` opens when tonight's total is above last night's.

panels.title: Executions, by result
panels.description: Completed executions of `feed-ingest-everon-sync` (`feeds everon sync --scheduled`), by result. One failed run opens `feed-ingest-failed` (the Everon importer's run failed), never retried: the next slot (06:00, 14:00, 22:00 Chicago time) is the retry. None at all: not deployed (beta's feed_ingest_enabled off), its schedule paused (feed_ingest_paused), or no run yet; its deadline tile above says which.

panels.title: Its schedule could not start it
panels.description: Cloud Scheduler's attempts to start the importer that finished in error, by status (`scheduler-failed` pages on one). PERMISSION_DENIED means its runner binding (row 205) is not what the gate thinks.

panels.title: Its run, while it runs
panels.description: The importer's task while it runs (`job/running_task_attempts`, the most in each interval): a run's bar lasts as long as it ran. Its limit is 2h10m (7800 s); `job-timeout-feed-ingest-everon-sync` opens at 80% of it.

panels.title: Executions, by job and result
panels.description: migrate-tpa, seed-tpa, tpa-db-export, records-chain-head and the restore drill.

panels.title: Schedules that could not start their job
panels.description: `scheduler-failed` in the PHI project; `audit-chain` for the chain head.

panels.title: Job resources: app project (tpa-jobs, auth's jobs, the importer, the synthetic journeys; the CRM's in beta) (attempts, run length, CPU, memory)
Task attempts, by job and result
panels.description: Each task attempt that finished (`job/completed_task_attempt_count`), by job and result. A job here runs one task and no retry, so an attempt is a run.

panels.title: Tasks running, by job (each run's length)
panels.description: Task attempts running (`job/running_task_attempts`), the most in each interval: a run's bar lasts as long as its task ran. The module's `job-timeout-<job>` opens at 80% of a job's timeout.

panels.title: Killed for memory, or failed to start, by job
panels.description: A job's container killed for exceeding its memory limit (`run_oom_kills`; `run-oom` pages on one), or Cloud Run's system log at ERROR for it (`run_system_errors`; `canary-startup`).

panels.title: CPU, by job (p99)
panels.description: Each job's container CPU, the share of its limit in use (`container/cpu/utilizations`), the 99th percentile in each interval while it runs. No policy reads a job's CPU: a slow job shows as a long bar above.

panels.title: Memory, by job (p99)
panels.description: Each job's container memory, the share of its limit in use (`container/memory/utilizations`), the 99th percentile in each interval while it runs. At the limit the task is killed (`run-oom`).
